where: outdoor, behind the sandbag line west of the colony
state: You are crouched behind the sandbags, rifle ready, heart pounding.
trigger: A raider's bullet tears into {O}'s left shoulder and {O} drops against the sandbags, bleeding. {O} is still gripping a rifle.

where: indoors, kitchen with a stone floor, clean
state: You are at the end of a long day, a bit tired.
trigger: A fuel-soaked stove flare-up sets {O}'s sleeves alight. {O} runs out the door, screaming, and rolls on the dirt.
ledger: {O} has second-degree burns on both arms

where: indoors, hospital with two beds, dim and a little dirty
state: You are awake, a bit tired, standing near the medical beds.
trigger: {O} is lying in a bed with an infected gut wound and a fever. The medicine stock is down to two herbal.

where: outdoor, the colony graveyard edge, beside a fresh corpse
state: You are standing still, tired and quiet.
trigger: {O}'s closest friend died of blood loss an hour ago and {O} is staring at the body without moving. Nobody has carried it to the grave yet.

where: outdoor, the east field, blood on the grass
state: You are standing near the edge of the field, tense and out of breath.
trigger: {O} was downed by the last raider and bled out in the dirt before anyone could reach {O}. The raid is over and the field is silent.

where: indoors, dining room, cluttered
state: You are sitting nearby, a bit tired and hungry.
trigger: {O} snaps at the cook, then starts a food binge, tearing through the pantry and eating raw meat off the shelf.
ledger: Food stock: 14 meals, low on raw

where: indoors, rec room with a billiards table, loud
state: You are in the middle of a game, a bit restless.
trigger: {O} flings a chair across the rec room, shouts, and starts a tantrum, smashing the billiards table.

where: outdoor, the back gate, wind blowing
state: You are standing at your post, cold and a bit tired.
trigger: {O} drops a tool, mutters that this is pointless, and walks out the back gate toward the mountains. {O} has no jacket.

where: outdoor, colony entrance, nothing cleared
state: You are on watch, a bit tired but alert.
trigger: The alert siren goes off and six raiders in tribal gear are creeping out of the fog with spears and bows. {O} is already running for the armory.
ledger: Raid: 6 tribal raiders, arriving from the north

where: indoors, workshop, well lit
state: You are working at the bench, focused, a bit proud.
trigger: Your Crafting skill just reached level 10 and the bench feels familiar. {O} notices and nods without comment.

where: outdoor, a patch of dirt near the stockpile, no table nearby
state: You are hungry and standing with a plate.
trigger: The dining room is full, so you and {O} eat on the dirt with no table. Both of you have the thought 'ate without a table' pending.
ledger: Thought: ate without a table (-3 mood)

where: indoors, dining room, clean
state: You are sitting at the table, hungry and tired.
trigger: The cook serves raw insect jelly and a bowl of kibble. {O} pushes the kibble around the plate and says nothing.

where: indoors, dining room with a lit fireplace, clean
state: You are seated at a table, content, a bit tired.
trigger: The cook sets down a lavish meal of roast muffalo and vegetables. {O} sits down across from you and takes the first bite.
ledger: Thought: ate a lavish meal (+12 mood)

where: indoors, kitchen, clean, a pot simmering
state: You are at the stove, steady and a bit tired.
trigger: A pile of rice and raw meat is on the counter waiting to be cooked. {O} arrives with more corn and asks how many meals are left.
ledger: Bill: cook simple meal x 12 (4 done)

where: underground, mine tunnel, dim, cave walls close
state: You are swinging a pick, dusty, a bit tired.
trigger: The pick strikes a vein of steel. {O} hauls the chunks to the stockpile and warns that the roof looks thin here.
ledger: Roof: thin in the east tunnel

where: outdoor, hunting grounds in thick brush
state: You are crouched with a rifle, quiet, a bit hungry.
trigger: A muffalo grazes forty tiles off. {O} stays back with the pack animal, ready to carry the carcass home.

where: outdoor, the battlefield near the colony wall, strewn with corpses
state: You are dragging a body, grim and a bit tired.
trigger: There are five raider corpses to haul to the burial pit before they rot. {O} lifts another by the arms and gags at the smell.

where: indoors, research room with a research bench, clean
state: You are at the bench, focused, a bit tired.
trigger: The microscope shows the current project is 80% done. {O} brings coffee and asks if the electricity project is next.

where: outdoor, a bench outside the main door, wet
state: You are sitting idle, a bit bored.
trigger: Rain has been falling for three days. {O} says the crops will rot if it does not stop and asks how long you think it will last.

where: indoors, the rec room, quiet
state: You are idle with nothing to do, a bit bored.
trigger: {O} drops into the chair next to you and complains there has been nothing to do since the last raid. {O} asks whether the colony will ever be anything more than a dirt farm.

where: outdoor, the courtyard, cold wind
state: You are idle, a bit tired, still sore.
trigger: {O} brings up the argument from last week about who left the freezer door open. Neither of you has apologised, and the meat was ruined.

where: indoors, the dining room, warm
state: You are relaxed, a bit tired.
trigger: {O} tries a joke about a thrumbo walking into a colony and gets half the punchline wrong. The silence afterward goes on a little too long.

where: indoors, the prison cell, cramped, one bed
state: You are standing at the cell door, wary and a bit tired.
trigger: A captured raider lies on the cell bed, arm in a splint, glaring at the door. {O} says the recruit attempt is next and asks who will talk.

where: outdoor, the graveyard, small stone markers, dry grass
state: You are standing in a circle with the others, quiet and tired.
trigger: The funeral begins around the grave of a colonist who died last week. {O} stands with bowed head near the coffin and is the first to speak.

where: indoors, the storeroom, filling with smoke
state: You are running, out of breath and alarmed.
trigger: A short circuit has set the wood stockpile alight and the fire is spreading toward the wall. {O} is grabbing a bucket's worth of nothing and shouting for help.

where: outdoor, the landing area near the colony gate
state: You are standing near the caravan, curious and a bit tired.
trigger: A trade caravan from an outlander settlement arrives with muffalo and camels, and a trader waves a hand toward the colony. {O} says the silver is low and asks what to sell.
